svg.title: Azure Service Health to Slack operator architecture
svg.desc: Numbered Service Health events cross Global Azure Monitor resources into an Easy Auth protected Container App in East US 2, then reach Slack. Separate delivery, private network, managed identity RBAC, data, and observability paths explain the supporting resources in the Azure resource group.
svg.metadata: Source: Microsoft Azure Architecture Icons V24, https://arch-center.azureedge.net/icons/Azure_Public_Service_Icons_V24.zip. Terms: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/architecture/icons/#icon-terms. Official product artwork is embedded unmodified, uniformly scaled, and shown beside its Azure product name.
svg.text: Azure Service Health to Slack - operator architecture
One resource group, two Azure scopes, and five relationship types

g.text: Key Vault: Key Vault Secrets User
Container Apps platform and app logs
Global boundaries are dashed; East US 2 and VNet boundaries are solid. Private endpoint NICs are intentionally summarized, not drawn as separate nodes.
